title: 第19章 柳狂的刀第20章 欺人太甚
content_zh:
回到观众席，秦浩关注着其他擂台。
其中一个擂台，陈运天一剑轻松击飞对手，成功获胜。
不少人议论着。
“嘶！
陈运天好厉害的剑法！
他的对手是淬体境六重巅峰修为，竟然被一剑击败！”
“陈运天不愧是排名第一的种子选手，他施展的《两仪剑法》，只怕达到了大成之境！”
“这陈运天，近两年闭关苦修，看来实力提升很多。”
秦浩微微点头，沉吟片刻，将目光转移到了其他擂台。
毫无疑问，陈运天隐藏了自身实力。
不过，秦浩并不在意，他《天穹剑法》大成，更是领悟了剑势！
哪怕修为超过自己一个境界，他也有信心一战。
与此同时，柳狂也成功击败了对手。
与陈运天的风轻云淡不同，柳狂出手极为狠辣。
一招，便将对手打得口吐鲜血，倒在地上昏死过去。
连投降的机会都没有。
如此狠辣手段，也引起众人一片哗然。
“咦，这人是谁？竟然也这么轻松击败对手。”
突然，秦浩的目光被一名身穿粗布衣衫的少年吸引。
少年手握一柄长枪，神情平静，枪法稳重狠准，仅仅一枪，便将对手逼得跳下擂台。

而他的对手，乃是一名淬体境六重后期的武者。
“此战，刘逍胜！”
裁判的声音传来。
秦浩眼中闪过一抹诧异，深深看了眼名叫刘逍的少年。
上午时间很快过去，天才战的战斗也越来越激烈。
经过几轮比赛，此刻，已然到了争夺前十的关键一轮。
获得前十，便能得到万象殿的奖励。
“给我败！”
秦方大吼一声，一招剑法横劈，将对手击退，随即铁剑连连进攻，快若闪电，只是刹那，便将那人给逼退到擂台边缘。
眼看就要被击中，那人无奈跳下擂台。
“秦方，胜！”
哗……
许多秦家子弟顿时哗然，目光兴奋、崇拜。
秦方很兴奋，很享受这种被人崇拜的感觉，顿时豪情万丈，“秦家崛起，还是要靠我秦方！
content_en:
Returning to the auditorium, Qin Hao paid attention to other arenas.
In one of the arenas, Chen Yuntian easily knocked away his opponent with one sword and successfully won.
Many people were talking about it.
"Hiss!
Chen Yuntian’s swordsmanship is so amazing!
His opponent was at the peak of the sixth level of Body Tempering Realm, but he was defeated by a sword! "
"Chen Yuntian is worthy of being the number one seed player. His "Liang Yi Sword Technique" has probably reached the level of great success!"
"This Chen Yuntian has been practicing hard in seclusion for the past two years. It seems that his strength has improved a lot."
Qin Hao nodded slightly, pondered for a moment, and turned his attention to other arenas.
There is no doubt that Chen Yuntian has hidden his own strength.
However, Qin Hao didn't care. He had mastered the "Tianqiong Sword Technique" and even understood the power of the sword!
Even if his cultivation level is one level higher than his own, he still has the confidence to fight.
At the same time, Liu Kuang also successfully defeated his opponent.
Unlike Chen Yuntian's calm demeanor, Liu Kuang's attacks were extremely ruthless.
With one move, the opponent was beaten until he vomited blood and fell to the ground unconscious.
Not even a chance to surrender.
Such ruthless tactics also caused an uproar among the people.
"Hey, who is this person? He defeated his opponent so easily."
Suddenly, Qin Hao's eyes were attracted by a young man wearing coarse clothes.
The young man held a spear in his hand, with a calm expression, and his shooting skills were steady and accurate. With just one shot, he forced his opponent to jump off the ring.
And his opponent was a warrior in the late sixth level of the Body Tempering Realm.
"Liu Xiaosheng wins this battle!"
The referee's voice came.
Qin Hao's eyes flashed with surprise, and he took a deep look at the young man named Liu Xiao.
The morning passed quickly, and the battle between geniuses became more and more intense.
After several rounds of competition, it was now the crucial round to compete for the top ten.
If you get into the top ten, you will be rewarded by the Wanxiang Palace.
"Defeat me!"
Qin Fang roared loudly, and knocked his opponent back with a horizontal sword move. Then he attacked with his iron sword, as fast as lightning. In just a moment, he forced the man back to the edge of the ring.
Seeing that he was about to be hit, the man had no choice but to jump off the ring.
"Qin Fang, win!"
Wow...
Many Qin family disciples were immediately in an uproar, with excited and admiring eyes.
Qin Fang was very excited and enjoyed the feeling of being admired. He was filled with pride and said, "The rise of the Qin family still depends on me, Qin Fang!
